description: This file is a shell script used for platform-specific firmware upgrade procedures within the OpenWrt project. It defines functions to check and perform firmware upgrades on various hardware boards, handling different partition schemes and bootloader configurations.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is compatible with the current board by verifying bootloader strings or using redboot-specific checks.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process tailored to specific hardware models, managing partitions and bootloader configurations.
